SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT t.user_id, t.workspace_role, t.is_personal_role, t.source_type, t.source_dept_id, t.assigned_by_id, t.assigned_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.user_id ORDER BY t.priority DESC, FIELD(t.workspace_role, 'OWNER', 'MAINTAINER', 'DEVELOPER', 'REPORTER') ) AS rn FROM ( SELECT m.user_id AS user_id, m.workspace_role AS workspace_role, 0 AS is_personal_role, 'DIRECT' AS source_type, NULL AS source_dept_id, m.created_by AS assigned_by_id, m.created_at AS assigned_at, 2 AS priority FROM platform_workspace_member m WHERE m.workspace_code = #{workspaceCode} AND m.source = 'DIRECT' AND m.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT ud.user_id AS user_id, COALESCE(p.workspace_role, wd.default_role) AS workspace_role, CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_personal_role, 'DEPT' AS source_type, wd.dept_id AS source_dept_id, COALESCE(p.created_by, wd.created_by) AS assigned_by_id, COALESCE(p.created_at, wd.created_at) AS assigned_at, CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS priority FROM platform_workspace_dept wd JOIN system_dept root ON root.id = wd.dept_id AND root.is_deleted = 0 JOIN system_dept sub ON (sub.id = root.id OR sub.path LIKE CONCAT(root.path, root.id, '/%')) AND sub.is_deleted = 0 JOIN system_user_dept ud ON ud.dept_id = sub.id AND ud.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN platform_workspace_member p ON p.workspace_code = #{workspaceCode} AND p.user_id = ud.user_id AND p.source = 'PERSONAL' AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE wd.workspace_code = #{workspaceCode} AND wd.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM platform_workspace_member ex WHERE ex.workspace_code = #{workspaceCode} AND ex.user_id = ud.user_id AND ex.source = 'EXCLUDED' AND ex.is_deleted = 0 ) ) t ) ranked
